results.fact: September: 'outside the best season' vs best_season/season Jul-Sep
results.evidence: On screen the season chip (Jul-Sep) is the climbing season and SEASONAL GUIDANCE shows its own optimal window (mid-July through August) with September marked marginal; a marginal month inside the season is a best window inside a season, not a conflict. best_season (which runs through September) is not rendered because seasonal_guidance is present. A late-season report of the Lucky Pass line melting to ice also fits 'marginal'.

results.fact: total elevation gain to the crag
results.evidence: Decision rule 4: gain_ft 4,400 is provably wrong. One trail guide states Lake Viviane is reached at 9.3 mi after climbing 6,400 vertical feet; other guides put 3,800-4,100 ft on the Snow Lakes trail to Snow Lakes alone, with a further ~1,400 ft up to Lake Viviane; and the net rise from the ~1,300 ft trailhead to the ~6,785 ft lake already exceeds 5,400 ft. Only one source states a cumulative figure to the lake, so there is no sourced replacement; gain_ft is cleared, leaving the waypoint note's ~6,400 ft as the only stated gain.
